d:
Somvar ki subah dilli ke kaee ilaqon men pradushan ki sthiti behad kharab darj ki gaee. kaee ilaqon men ekyuaaee 400 ke qarib darj kiya gaya hai. kaee ilakon men vizibliti kafi kam paee gaee hai. kuchh ilaqon men to logon ko kafi qarib ki chizen bhi nahin dikh rahi hain. dilli men indiya get ke aaspas aae logon ne pradushan ke halat par kya kaha, dekhie yah riport.
Vidiyoh dilanvaz pasha aur shad midhat
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
